channel.title: Octopus incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Octopus's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: https://g.octopushq.com Certificate issues [resolved]
item.description: This issue has now been resolved. Thank you for your patience whilst we investigated the incident. If you are having any further issues please email support@octopus.com.

item.title: Service connectivity issues due to upstream Azure outage [resolved]
Bicep deployments may fail after upgrading to 2026.3.4658 or later [resolved]
item.description: The fix has been live across all Octopus Cloud servers for several weeks now without further issues.

item.title: Ability to deploy in West US 2 might be affected [resolved]
item.description: Our upstream provider, Azure in West US2, has resolved their issue. While the issue was ongoing, some Octopus Cloud instances in West US2 may have experienced brief downtime and network communication issues. For more details, see Azure's incident report (Tracking ID: GHRP-84G) at https://azure.status.microsoft/en-us/status/history/.

item.title: Amazon ECS Service Steps fail with 'Container.image contains invalid cha... [resolved]
item.description: We have pushed out a fix for this issue and it should be rolling out to Octopus Cloud customers over the next few days. Please contact support@octopus.com if you are seeing this issue and we can arrange to get your instance upgraded.

item.title: Dynamic Worker issues in West US 2 [resolved]
item.description: We have not observed any further issues in the West US 2 region so all Octopus Cloud instances in the West US 2 region are using dynamic workers in West US 2 once again.

item.title: AWS Deployment Failures for Cloud Customers [resolved]
Deployments using AWS-dependent resources may fail with “No RegionEndpoint or ServiceURL configured.” [resolved]
item.description: We have identified the cause of this issue and have produced a fix in Octopus version 2026.2.3825. Please email support@octopus.com if you are seeing AWS region endpoint errors in your deployments similar to the one in the title and we can discuss upgrade options.

item.title: gRPC port (8443) shows Octopus Cloud instance is Undergoing Maintenance [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. Please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team if you are still having any related problems.

item.title: Emails are currently not being delivered [resolved]
item.description: Email services have now been restored. Please contact support@octopus.com if you encounter any issues with email delivery.

item.title: Ubuntu Dynamic Workers are failing to lease [postmortem]
item.description:
# Summary
On 2 Feb 2026, between 20:13:34 to 22:56:04 UTC, Octopus Cloud customers in `West US 2` and `West Europe` may have experienced failed deployments or failed runbook runs due to `Ubuntu Dynamic Worker` steps failing on Leasing timeout.
This disruption was caused by Azure failing to provision Virtual Machines across multiple regions - see Azure Issue `FNJ8-VQZ` on [Azure Status History](https://azure.status.microsoft/en-us/status/history/).

item.description:
# Intermittent sign-in issues for Octopus Cloud instances
## Summary
Between November 25, at 10:24 pm AEST, and November 26, at 12:58 am AEST, customers experienced sporadic issues signing into Octopus Cloud instances. These issues stemmed from a database connection leak, which caused some sign-in requests to time out. We apologize for the inconvenience this has caused our customers and are taking steps to prevent it from happening again.
### Timings
Time to detection: 9hrs 41mins
Time to incident declaration: 9hrs 41mins
Time to resolution: 12hrs 15mins

item.title: Docker Hub authentication issues [postmortem]
item.description:
# **Incident Summary**
Docker Hub experienced authentication issues that prevented access to container images, resulting in deployment failures for projects relying on those images.
## **What We're Doing**
Following this incident, we've identified several improvements to enhance service resilience and customer communication:
### **Visibility & Monitoring**
* Communicate third-party service outages more clearly on our status page * Explore in-app messaging to alert customers during service disruptions
### **Resilience & Good Practices**
* Review image retrieval reliability and address identified risks * Share good practices with customers to help reduce impacts when Docker Hub is unavailable
